body:
The reviewed `git_init.initialBranch` shell-injection path was hidden by imported TypeScript registration wrappers and composed Zod metadata. Preserve proved local exports, promisify identities and handler invocation boundaries, then retain the seven-input advisory case as a current-candidate offline CI gate. Add reviewed feedback intake and maintenance guidance, and prepare version 1.4.0 with all accepted changes since 1.3.0.

The technical result is explicitly accepted: 14 advisory observations / seven equal report pairs, 14 original-advisory compatibility observations, 106 non-FAF historical reports / 53 equal pairs, and an actual deliberate detector regression rejected by the CI assertion. All 56 unrelated advisory finding occurrences remain `needs_review`. The accepted candidate passed all 30 hosted jobs, documentation and 12 native suites; this update requires fresh hosted verification of the selected 1.4.0 version.

The current FAF timeout remains failed, with no report and five unstarted observations closed. Its current detection/support/repeat compatibility remains unestablished. Preserve Phase 22's accepted limitations, unsupported Proxmox, deferred recovery/optimization, pilots and paid benchmarks. No paid calls or advisory-target execution.

Release scope includes SENT-012–016 and the existing native 1.7.0 report schema; canonical findings, rule meanings, baseline matching, suppression and exit-code contracts remain. Publication, merge, signed tag and Action alias actions require separate approval after the exact hosted artifacts are reviewed. Phase 23 remains open until verified publication and explicit final acceptance.

Selected-version validation: corrected full `make check` passed 2,766 tests / 36 skips, including the dependency audit and strict documentation build. The original eight failures came from historical 1.3.0 captures used as synthetic current reports; a five-line test-only correction sets the installed version in memory and verifies each unchanged drift-control baseline. All 52 focused checks pass; production comparator and frozen references are unchanged. Both failed and successful runs remain retained.
title: Prepare 1.4.0 with maintained advisory regression and feedback
